camera_height_m: at the lip of the entry tunnel, about 0.30 above its floor
angle: high oblique, tilted down into the shaft
start_frame: Darkness with hawthorn roots across the top of frame: Alice crawling forward on her front along the low earth tunnel, lit only from the opening behind her; the dark mouth of the tunnel matched in size and screen position to sh016.
end_frame: The same frame as the floor tips away under her hands and she drops clean out of the bottom of it, leaving the empty tunnel lip and the black below.
constraint_honoured: 'Set-up 1 of the licensed three; the recognised wide is held back to sh022' — one fixed set-up, and the sh016 oval match is preserved by not moving.
movement_note: S03 is built from three reusable set-ups and no move in any of them; the fall's energy comes from her dropping out of frame, not from the camera chasing her.
